subroutes.description: Current optimizer universe and allocation controls using local historical data.

conditional_inputs.required_when: optimizer universe is derived from current scan cache
sector cap or trusted sector display is enabled
current dashboard page-render branch requires fundamentals_wide is not None

fail_closed_conditions: price source missing
returns missing when optimizer/replay output depends on returns
ticker map missing for selected or nonzero-weight asset
price/return slot corruption
duplicate dates or duplicate asset columns in selected matrix
nonfinite required selected values
selected asset endpoint stale beyond policy
live overlay/provider refresh needed to make selected asset current
scan cache missing or malformed when scan-derived optimizer universe is required

subroutes.description: Daily replay, YTD chart, allocation snapshot, and strategy replay context.

conditional_inputs.required_when: strict boot is asked to certify saved artifact reuse

fail_closed_conditions: PIT universe missing or malformed
PIT window does not cover requested replay dates
duplicate (date, permno) in PIT checked window
selected replay asset not in PIT membership for as-of window
ticker mapping missing for selected replay asset
route selection only exists in Streamlit session state and no durable request was supplied to the gate
saved artifact would be reused but dashboard_cache_signature, controls, method, date_window, source signatures, row counts, schema, or identity mismatch
replay build would be required to certify output

conditional_inputs.required_when: benchmark metrics are displayed as trusted
conditional_inputs.path: loader_return:prices_wide[SPY,QQQ] or approved local benchmark source

fail_closed_conditions: benchmark data missing when trusted benchmark metrics are displayed
benchmark live overlay lacks same-column overlap anchor
provider call required to refresh benchmark

strict_behavior.missing_replay_artifact: WARN unless saved-artifact-only certification is requested
